decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - ?	Non-Std - The materials to be used in the bricking up of the windows around the extract vent above the proposed extension shall match those used in the existing rear elevation of the building.

Condition : 7 - ?	Non Std - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the roof together with details of how the roofing material will be fixed to the building of the hereby approved extension have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of a single storey kitchen extension to the public house.
